# Patches to vendored CORE-MATH

Each `*.patch` here is a unified diff against the files of `extern/core-math/` as fetched
at the pin (`patch -p1`, paths relative to `extern/core-math/`), applied in name order by
`tools/revendor-core-math.sh`. Every patch is recorded with its reason in
`extern/core-math/NOTES.md` and proven equal to unpatched CORE-MATH over the dense sets.

There are none at the pin `cac142bc65dc`.
